title: Menu sounds
description: ui/ui_sounds.yaml of the game pack: the sound effect each menu cue plays (docs/architecture/audio.md). A cue left out stays silent.

cursor.description: The focus or a menu's cursor moved; a move that moves nothing is silent.

cancel.description: The player backed out of a menu.

bank.description: A bank folder under sound/, such as ss or esall/003.

sound.description: The sound's value in the bank (the sounds list of its bank_meta.yaml).
